content.description:
Humans are problem solvers. We want to make meaning every day by solving problems we face, both individually and in collaboration with others. With our families and friends, in our communities, and if we are fortunate, with the organizations where we work, we solve problems all the time.

The purpose of Andamio is to increase the capacity of all people to collaborate in solving big problems.

Our mission is to support people to learn, organize, and share information enough to solve big problems.

We envision a world where people are inspired to solve big problems, audacious enough to know they can, and empowered enough to take action.
